import pandas as pd, numpy as np
p='/workspace/staging/final_scores.tsv'
df=pd.read_csv(p, sep='\\t', index_col=0)
print(df.shape)
print(df.columns.tolist())
score_cols=[c for c in df.columns if c.startswith('score_')]
print('samples',df['sample'].value_counts())
print('\\nMean scores by sample:')
print(df.groupby('sample')[score_cols].mean().T)
for thresh in [0,0.2,0.5]:
 print(f'\\n=== fraction cells score>{thresh} ===')
 tab=df.groupby('sample')[score_cols].apply(lambda x: (x>thresh).mean()).T
 tab['ratio_s1/s0']=tab[1]/tab[0].replace(0,np.nan)
 print(tab)
# max score classification
maxct=df[score_cols].idxmax(axis=1)
df2=df.copy(); df2['pred']=maxct
print('\\nMax-score class proportions by sample:')
tab=df2.groupby('sample')['pred'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack().T.fillna(0)
tab['ratio_s1/s0']=tab[1]/tab[0].replace(0,np.nan)
print(tab.sort_values('ratio_s1/s0'))
# depletion measured ratio or difference? print sample0 and sample1 counts
print('\\nCounts:')
print(df2.groupby(['sample','pred']).size().unstack().T.fillna(0).astype(int))
PY"

'muller':['RLBP1','GLUL','SLC1A3','VIM','DKK3'],
'astrocyte':['GFAP','S100B','AQP4','SOX9','GJA1'],
'RPE':['RPE65','BEST1','LRAT','TTR','SERPINF1'],
'Tcells':['CD3D','CD3E','CD3G','CD2','TRAC','TRBC1','TRBC2'],
'macrophage':['CD68','LYZ','FCGR3A','MRC1','CD163'],

}

 totals=np.asarray(X.sum(axis=0)).ravel(); X=X.multiply(1/totals).tocsr()*10000; X.data=np.log1p(X.data); Xs.append(X)
X=sp.hstack(Xs, format='csr')
ns=[6295,5004]

 sub=X[idx,:]
 npos=(sub>0.5).sum(axis=0)
 mean_expr=np.asarray(sub.mean(axis=0)).ravel()

 call=(npos>=2)&(mean_expr>0.2)
 counts=[int(call[:ns[0]].sum()), int(call[ns[0]:].sum())]
 print(f'{ct:12s} counts s0,s1={counts} frac={counts[0]/ns[0]:.4f},{counts[1]/ns[1]:.4f} ratio s1/s0={counts[1]/max(counts[0],1):.3f}')
